record.one_liner: Open-source Postgres development platform with auto-generated REST Data API, Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions.
record.auth_notes: Data API uses publishable and secret API keys (sb_publishable_ / sb_secret_) on the apikey header. critic: oauth2 confirmed - Management API supports OAuth2 apps (org settings > OAuth Apps) for third-party integrations; hosted MCP uses OAuth dynamic client registration with PAT as manual alternative.
record.access_notes: Free plan ($0) gives unlimited API requests with no paid plan or sales contact; limited to 2 active projects and pause after 1 week of inactivity. critic: confirmed.
record.api_notes: Data API is PostgREST auto-generated from the database schema at /rest/v1/; Management API covers orgs and projects.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed; no review or paid gate for credentials.

evidence.quote: Supabase supports four types of API keys:
Using OAuth2.0 you can retrieve an access and refresh token that grant your application full access to the Management API on behalf of the user.
This means that you don't need to manually create a personal access token (PAT) or OAuth app to use the server.
Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 active projects.
Supabase provides a RESTful API using PostgREST, a thin API layer on top of Postgres.
The Supabase MCP server provides tools organized into feature groups.
